hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); b=$(basename "$f" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$f" == */inputs/day-*.txt ]] || [[ "$b" == ".env" || "$b" == ".env.local" || "$b" == .env.*.local ]]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked by hook: puzzle inputs (inputs/day-*.txt) and .env files are protected from Write/Edit. Edit manually outside Claude Code if this is intentional."}}'; fi

hooks.statusMessage: Scanning staged changes for secrets and AoC-restricted files...

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then case "$f" in *.ts) npx eslint --fix "$f"; npx prettier --write "$f";; esac; fi 2>/dev/null || true
